Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level/paymentId are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field. Payment is one of the platform's 100%-trace-coverage services.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

ConnectionStrings._comment_PaymentDatabase: Write-side PostgreSQL - source of truth for PaymentIntent/Refund/IdempotencyRecord/GatewayWebhookEvent (database-design.md). Secret in production - supplied via ConnectionStrings__PaymentDatabase env var / K8s Secret, never committed.

Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Read-side MongoDB (sharded in production) - the CQRS query side, per the user's explicit requirement (contracts/README.md deviation #1). Secret in production.

Gateway._comment_SigningSecrets: Per-gateway HMAC signing secrets for POST /v1/payments/webhooks/{gateway} (BRD §22, Kubernetes Secret in production).
